title: Quaint Charred Middle Eastern Beef Fillet Mansaf
description: A romantic Middle Eastern dish featuring charred beef fillet, served with a cheese pull and a touch of sweetness from candy, all while being keto-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef fillet with sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over high heat and sear the beef fillet for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook the beef fillet to an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the beef is cooking, mix jameed with chopped pistachios and a pinch of salt.
Once the beef is cooked, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly.
To assemble the mansaf, place the sliced beef on a platter, top it with the jameed mixture, and sprinkle with sugar-free candy and akkawi cheese.
Return the platter to the oven and cook until the cheese is melted and slightly charred.
Remove the platter from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
